notes:
Summary: Mid-market product analytics SaaS. Primary goal: embed fast, consistent chat and doc-search into product with strict latency SLAs and cost controls. Evaluated Hosted API first (good dev experience), now moving to Dedicated POC for predictable throughput + isolation. POC scope: two production-like environments (canary + main), reserved capacity suggestion from Redwood: 2x A100-equivalent GPU pool with autoscale headroom for bursts.

Requirements / constraints:
- Latency: target p95 <= 200ms for conversational chat; p99 monitored. Throughput target ~150 QPS for peak product tier.
- Cost sensitivity: medium-high. Want clear token-level cost breakdown and Optimize suggestions to hit cost targets.
- Models: prefer open/quantizable models (Llama2-like, Mistral variants). Need Redwood to validate quantized variant parity for our prompts.
- Routing/fallback: must have canary rollouts + automated fallbacks. Plan: 5% traffic to canary Dedicated nodes for 14d with automated quality and latency gates; fallback to hosted_api (cheaper but higher-latency) on health/quality/regression detection; regional failover us-east-1 -> us-west-2 for infra incidents.
- Security: SSO/SAML, SOC2 attestation, KMS for key management, audit logs ingested into our SIEM, retention 365d for request metadata.

POC acceptance criteria (agreed):
- Canary stability: no >3% request error rate, p95 <= 220ms, semantic quality measured via eval set (embedding/response similarity) within 5% of baseline hosted model
- Cost: demonstrate 20% unit-cost improvement with caching/batching and quantization compared to hosted baseline under same workload profile
- Observability: token-level cost dashboards, per-route tracing, and rollback hooks exercised in runbook

Technical notes (from SE call):
- Will run synthetic and production shadow traffic. SE proposed KV prefix caching for common customer prompts and workload-aware batching to reduce per-token cost.
- Canary plan: traffic tag header to route 5% -> dedicated-canary; gating includes latency, error-rate, and automated evaluation against golden prompt set. If evaluation falls below threshold, automatic rollback to prior model variant and route back to hosted_api.
- Region failover: config via routing policy (primary us-east-1, secondary us-west-2). Ops need runbook for DR and a 3-phase test window.

- Head of Platform (N. Rivera): 'Budget will clear if we can show a 3-6 month ROI on token spend.'
